title: Earthy Snappy Ukrainian Fry Fritters
description: A hearty, gluten-free Ukrainian dish featuring crispy fritters with a rich red pepper paste.
instructions: Combine gluten-free flour, fry, red pepper paste, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Add onion and mix until just combined.
Beat in egg and sour cream until the mixture forms a sticky dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the fritters for 3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
